integrity: Exact analytic proof and its normalization, endpoint and sharpness checks are included. No external independent audit or validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The coefficient 2 log 2 - 1 is sharp uniformly over N>=2, not claimed separately sharp for each N>2. Only the critical Hilbertian weighted disk norm is considered; unweighted L1 and arbitrary other weights are outside scope. Prior unindexed equivalent stability bounds remain a priority risk. Numerical diagnostics are supplementary to the proof.
title: A globally sharp, size-uniform angular stability law for the critical Bergman pole problem
